title: Create: Overdrive!
description: Create Mod with a bunch of its popular addons! Also includes some QOL and terrain generation mods.
body: Looking for a Create Mod modpack? Well this is it! This modpack includes the Create Mod, aswell as some of its most popular addons. Create factories, mine for oil, manufacture cars and planes, and deploy massive cannons to defend you base. Explore the beatiful world generation and find new structures and enchanced villages to help you on your journey. Anything is possible!
